info.title: Mohammad Style B1B isolated admin API
info.description: Review profile of Phase03A v1 contracts. Local only; no login/production/booking/payment endpoints. Exact Origin and CSRF required for mutations. Decimal strings for bigint. Admin-only projections retain explicit nulls. Scope selectors are never authority.

servers.description: Isolated local API; Secure cookies require future reviewed HTTPS for browser login

SessionCookie.name: ms_session
SessionCookie.description: Proposed opaque HttpOnly Secure SameSite session; hash at rest. Customer self/branch/resource checks. Selected authentication enrollment/OTP/IdP protocol remains an approval gate.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfHeader.description: Required for cookie-authenticated mutation only; GET and read-only availability do not require CSRF. Origin checks remain mandatory.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Actor+route scope, canonical body hash, replay-safe durable result. Not a credential.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted current row/config version; missing/stale returns412.

BranchWrite.description: IANA timezone allowlist; bookable requires separately verified hours/offerings/staff/resources/policy. Deactivation cannot silently cancel occupied plans.

amountRial.description: Integer decimal string; <=9223372036854775807 and multiple of 10 in IRR_RIAL_V1 MVP. No exponent/fraction/sign.

OfferingWrite.description: Unknown is null. active requires all verified values, qualifications/membership and confirmed resource requirements. Configuration change checks live allocations under shared locks.

amountRial.description: Integer decimal string; <=9223372036854775807 and multiple of 10 in IRR_RIAL_V1 MVP. No exponent/fraction/sign.

Money.description: Exact integer money. Bounds, sum, safe conversion and currency checks are server invariants; see ADR-007.

Version.description: Opaque row/config version, not a floating point number.
